subject.title: fix: stop model fallback on sandbox provisioning failures

question: Does the sandbox owner approve treating all failures thrown during sandbox backend creation as non-provider coordination errors that abort model fallback?
rationale: This is an intentional runtime-boundary and compatibility decision: the code is narrowly scoped and tested, but owners must confirm the backend-factory contract does not include provider/model failures that should remain retryable.

options.title: Approve the sandbox boundary
options.body: Confirm backend creation is exclusively local provisioning and proceed after a refreshed current-main merge verification.

options.title: Narrow the classification contract
options.body: Require an explicit backend-factory error contract or narrower wrapping point if any backend startup path can represent a retryable provider/model failure.

recommendation.title: Approve the sandbox boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm backend creation is exclusively local provisioning and proceed after a refreshed current-main merge verification.
